name: NeonCore Orchestrator
short_description: Multi-model orchestrator for AI agents and workflows
detailed_description: NeonCore is a real-time dashboard for orchestrating multiple AI agents across VS Code instances. Run collaborative multi-model workflows (Claude Code, Gridlight, OpenAI), manage agent permissions, relay commands, and monitor activity — all from a single interface.
usage_instructions: Start the server, connect your VS Code instances with the NeonCore extension, and manage all your AI agents and workflows from the dashboard.
author: Gridlight
